name: WatchParty Video Feed and Search Verification
description: Verifies that WatchParty loads initial YouTube videos on home feed, search works properly, and clicking a video card transitions to the player view.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage at https://watchparty-fnxs.onrender.com
Verify that the header logo, search bar, and room status pill are visible
Verify that video cards are loaded and displayed in the video grid with titles and thumbnails
Click on the first video card in the video grid
Verify that the watch view opens, displaying the video title, channel information, and YouTube iframe player
